## [3.101.0] - 2026-10-27

### Features

- add customer selection and new order shortcuts (NEXO-656)

### Bug Fixes

- stabilize local keyboard focus and quantity drafts
- enable NEXO keyboard throughout label printing
- restore catalog filters and NEXO keyboard
- keep refund gift cards out of redemption flow (NEXO-656)
- reset shortcut ownership on POS and account changes (NEXO-656)
- enable Android USB sticker printing

### Other Changes

- fix nullable JSON argument in shortcut sync test (NEXO-656)
- Revert "fix(pos): keep refund gift cards out of redemption flow (NEXO-656)"
- Enabled shortcuts
- Add localization support for kiosk loyalty signup phone dialogs and update UI components
